name: Murderous Touch
body:
School necromancy [death]; Level cleric 7

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one living creature
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Fortitude partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

Your hand glows with dark, necromantic energy. When you touch a living creature, negative energy flows from your hand into your victim and opens a throbbing wound in the creature’s heart. If the creature fails a Fortitude save, it is instantly slain. If the Fortitude save is successful, the creature is staggered for one round but takes no damage.
